description: Concorde NEO is a two- and three-bedroom apartment community on Thanisandra Main Road at Bellahalli. Concorde describes 424 homes across 4.02 acres, with a sky-level clubhouse as a central feature. Open spaces, shared recreation and the elevated clubhouse give the project a recognisable community and leisure proposition.

content.faqsTitle: Six things to know about Concorde NEO

faqs.question: Where exactly is Concorde NEO located?
faqs.answer: Thanisandra Main Road, Markandhaiha Nagar, R. K. Hegde Nagar, Bellahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560064. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: 2 BHK, 3 BHK. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 1130–1539 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹1.35 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Under construction. Published timeline: October 2029. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Swimming Pool, Kids Play Area, Jogging Track, Senior Citizen Area, Kids Pool, Outdoor Gym. 70+ developer-marketed amenities. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: 4.02 acres with 424 homes 2B plus G plus 18 floor arrangement 78 percent open space reported by Concorde. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
